title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft HCM → JobClassification

source_objects.description: Job code: JOBCODE, DESCR, JOB_FAMILY, JOB_FUNCTION, SAL_ADMIN_PLAN, GRADE, EEO_JOB_GROUP, FLSA_STATUS, MANAGER_LEVEL, SOC_CD.
Faculty-specific fields (typically custom or via EMPL_CLASS): ACADEMIC_RANK, TENURE_STATUS, TENURE_DT. PS has no native tenure tracking — institutions build custom tables or use EMPL_CLASS.
For IPEDS faculty reporting: cross-reference EMPL_CLASS + JOB_FUNCTION + FTE to derive IPEDS faculty categories.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_JOBCODE_TBL.JOB_FUNCTION or derived from JOB_FAMILY hierarchy
Derived from department or custom faculty table
attribute_mappings.transformation: CIP code for faculty, linking to academic discipline.
Map: professor, associate, assistant, instructor, lecturer, visiting, emeritus, clinical, research.
Date tenure granted. Null if not tenured.
Map: full_time faculty, adjunct, emeritus, on_leave, visiting.
For IPEDS HR survey: 'Tenured', 'On Tenure Track', 'NTT Multi-Year', 'NTT Annual', 'NTT Less Than Annual'.

notes: PS has no native tenure/faculty-rank tracking. Most institutions use EMPL_CLASS to flag faculty (e.g., 'FAC', 'ADJ', 'GA') and build custom tables for tenure status and academic rank. The HELIX mapping documents the common pattern.
